title: Tier-4 bug fixes shipped as planning-PR prework (G18 + G19 + G20)
summary: Three small fixes from the SESSION-HANDOFF 'Pre-existing notes' section + repo audit, shipped together with the Phase G + H planning files. Independent of the implementation work; ships first because each is small and the regression tests give the implementation phases a stable baseline.

items.title: semh resolver order fix
items.fix: Removed `semh` from the anxiety regex at line 940; the dedicated SEMH matcher (line ~950) now wins for the bare token. The 'mental' token stays with anxiety because mental-health language is anxiety territory.
tests_added: resolveSendSpec routes bare 'semh' to the SEMH spec (3 cases)
anxiety / mental health still routes to anxiety
compound forms (social-emotional, emotional-mental) still route to semh

items.title: applySendFidelityAudit warning idempotency
items.fix: Replaced the unconditional `[...existingWarnings, ...finalReport.warnings]` merge with a Set-based dedupe loop that preserves order and drops string-equal duplicates. The fix is purely additive — first-call behaviour is unchanged.
tests_added: running applySendFidelityAudit twice produces no duplicates in postValidatorWarnings
pre-existing unrelated warnings are preserved without duplication

items.title: Delete WorksheetRenderer.tsx.bak
items.fix: Deleted the .bak duplicate. No reference in the codebase, no entry in .gitignore covered it. Reduces repo size + confusion.

acceptance_criteria: Existing tests at server/tests/worksheetScrutiny.test.ts:252 (SEMH content rules), 1480 (buildSelfReflection), 3198 (semh fidelity probes via 'social-emotional') all pass after the fix.
New tests added at the end of worksheetScrutiny.test.ts pass.
WorksheetRenderer.tsx (the live file) is unchanged — only the .bak duplicate is gone.
